companyContext: The LEGO Group is a Danish family-owned company founded in 1932 in Billund, Denmark. It designs, manufactures and sells interlocking plastic construction toys (LEGO bricks), licensed sets, video games, theme parks (LEGOLAND) and retail experiences, with the mission of inspiring and developing the builders of tomorrow through the power of play.
brandContext: LEGO is the global toy and entertainment brand behind the iconic LEGO brick system. The brand spans original themes (City, Friends, Creator, Technic, Icons, DUPLO) and licensed lines (Star Wars, Harry Potter, Disney, Marvel, Botanicals), sold through lego.com, official LEGO Stores and retail partners.

brandVision: Inspire and develop the builders of tomorrow. LEGO aims to leave a lasting positive impact on the planet by helping children learn through play, fueling creativity, imagination and lifelong curiosity in builders of every age.
brandValues: Imagination, creativity, fun, learning, caring and quality. The brand stands for playful, hands-on exploration, family togetherness, inclusivity, safety and sustainability – encapsulated in its founding motto 'leg godt' (play well).
